_eligibility_text: 1. Gaushalas and panjrapole registered under the Public Charity Act. 1. A Gaushala should have more than 50 cows of local origin. While Panjarapol must have more than 100 livestock. 1. At least 3 (three) acres of land on which the institution has to purchase/develop the development work, must be in the institution's own name or on a lease of 99 years. There is no maximum land limit.
